executiveSummary: System conditions remain stable and operational readiness across the hurricane protection system continues to be Green, with all major assets functioning and no threats to system integrity identified. First quarter inspections are complete and routine maintenance and operational activities remain on schedule. The agency remains operationally sound while advancing capital projects, workforce stabilization, cybersecurity enhancements, and pre-season readiness activities heading into the 2026 hurricane season.
maintenanceActivities: Crews completed 24 repairs to the earthen levee from in-house work orders.
Continued annual inspections/exercises of Hurricane gates — 45% complete; Q1 2026 valve inspections and exercises are complete.
Completed 27 repairs of surface spalls on floodwall sections, joints, and slope pavement; Deslonde St. levee access gate installed.
New wiring installed at police station for camera monitors; water meter on chiller 3 installed and tracking water usage weekly.
Staff attended demonstration of Scagg robotic mower on Monticello — determined it will not meet operational needs; purchase will not be pursued.
Maintenance will assist CPRA with planting 500 trees for ongoing mitigation project.
